xna-type.name: RenderTarget2D
xna-type.summary: Represents a 2D texture resource that will be written to at the end of a render pass.
xna-type.remarks: After a render pass the render target contains the color information of a rendered image. Render targets represent a linear area of display memory and usually resides in the display memory of the display card. Because of this, objects must be recreated when the device is reset.

constructor.summary: Creates an instance of this object.

parameters.parameter: The graphics device to associate with this render target resource.
Width, in pixels, of the render target. You can use graphicsDevice.PresentationParameters.BackBufferWidth to get the current screen width.
Height, in pixels, of the render target. You can use graphicsDevice.PresentationParameters.BackBufferHeight to get the current screen height.

exceptions.exception: There is not enough memory to create this resource.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of this class.
constructor.syntax: public RenderTarget2D ( GraphicsDevice graphicsDevice, int width, int height, int numberLevels, SurfaceFormat format )

parameters.parameter: The graphics device to associate with this render target resource.
Width, in pixels, of the render target.
Height, in pixels, of the render target.

The number of downsampled surfaces to create when preprocessing the texture. These smaller versions of the texture, known as mip levels, are used when the texture is minified to fit a smaller area than the original texture size. The chain of downsampled surfaces associated with a texture is sometimes called a mipmap chain. If this is zero, all texture sublevels down to 1×1 pixels will be generated for hardware that supports mipmapped textures.
Surface format of the render target.

exceptions.exception: One of the following conditions is true: width is larger than MaxTextureWidth. height is larger than MaxTextureHeight. The graphics device does not support creating a render target of type format. CheckDeviceFormat may be used to verify if a surface format is supported. format is SurfaceFormat.Unknown. Textures cannot be created using SurfaceFormat.Unknown. numberLevels is greater than 32. Textures have a maximum of 32 levels.
width or height is less than or equal to zero. width and height must be greater than zero.
Unable to create this RenderTarget2D resource on the graphics device.

property.name: DepthStencilFormat
property.summary: Gets the data format for the depth stencil data.
property.value: The data format of the depth data.

property.name: IsContentLost
property.summary: Determines if the index buffer data has been lost due to a lost device event.
property.value: True if the content was lost; false otherwise.

property.name: MultiSampleCount
property.summary: Gets the number of sample locations during multisampling.

property.name: RenderTargetUsage
property.summary: Gets or sets the render target usage.
property.value: The usage which detemines how data is used.

method.name: GetTexture
method.summary: Gets a copy of the 2D texture associated with this render target.

overload.summary: Gets a copy of the 2D texture associated with this render target.
overload.returns: A copy of the 2D texture associated with this render target.
